demo.headline: Watch what DreamReel can make.
demo.explanation: This deployment serves pre-rendered demo videos because the live generation pipeline needs to run on a host with FFmpeg. The MiniMax models (M3, H3, Music 3.0, Speech 2.8) are the same; only the composition step differs.
demo.enableBody: Run the API locally with FFmpeg available, or deploy a Cloudflare Container that hosts the composite step. Set the GMI_API_KEY secret and the pipeline lights up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notSignedIn: Please sign in to view settings.
settings.demoTitle: Settings are not available in this deployment.
settings.demoBody: This is a static demo. The MiniMax API key is configured at deploy time, not per-user. To enable per-user settings, deploy a self-hosted API with ffmpeg support.
settings.newKeyHint: Your key is stored encrypted in D1, scoped to your account. It is never logged or sent to the client after saving.
settings.confirmRemove: Remove your GMI API key? You'll need to set it again to generate new dreams.
settings.privacyNote: Your key is sent over HTTPS to the server, stored in your account row, and used only to call the GMI Cloud API on your behalf. It is never included in any response to the browser.
